paragraphs: In Shabbat, chapter 4, halakhah 2, Rabbi Yonah and Rabbi Yosi went up to Bar Ulla’s school and asked him.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 4:2 paragraph fully names Rabbi Yonah and Rabbi Yosi ascending to Bar Ulla’s school and asking him. The supplied chapter 4, halakhah 2 and direction remain; the old chapter-8 suggestion is preserved only in history. No school identity, authority binding, or extra legal discussion is imported.
